flags.message: Decisive forward signal predating the snapshot: the Court granted the government a stay of the preliminary injunction in this same case on June 23, 2025 (24A1153, 145 S. Ct. 2153) and a clarification on July 3, 2025 (145 S. Ct. 2627). Both are recited in the provisioned application and carried in my general knowledge; they are pre-event public information, not this event's outcome, and they drive most of the lift over the 10.5% pooled interim base rate.

The interim statpack pool for application Term 2026 (Terms 2016-2025) has resolved rows in only two Terms (2024: 70 resolved, 972 unparsed; 2025: 226 resolved). The pooled rate of 31/296 clears the floor of 50 but rests on one Term the poller reached only in part.
